blocking_methods.instructions: Call *66012424 (prefix your local STD code) / 080-49248000 / 044-47628000 — Priority Banking & Beyond Card 24-hour contact centre (alternate line — see notes).
blocking_methods.phone: *66012424 (prefix your local STD code) / 080-49248000 / 044-47628000 — Priority Banking & Beyond Card 24-hour contact centre

blocking_methods.instructions: Email customer.care@sc.com from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://retail.sc.com/in/nfs/login.htm and use the card block/hotlist option.

Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.app.scb.breeze.android.main.in.prod | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/sc-mobile-india/id460909294?ls=1

Block via Online Banking or SC Mobile: log in, select Help & Services > Card Management > Report Lost/Stolen Card; the card is blocked and a replacement sent to the registered mailing address. Hours: Personal Banking helpline is 8am-8pm IST but emergency services (report of loss card, unauthorised transaction, charge dispute, stop payment) continue to be serviced; Priority Banking & Beyond Card (*66012424 / 080-49248000 / 044-47628000) and Premium Banking (*66011500 / 080-49248500 / 044-47628500) lines are 24-hour contact centres. Overseas (International Banking helpline): Bahrain 80000448, UAE 8000177750, Hong Kong 800905108, Singapore 8001012407, Malaysia 1800815063, UK 8081019144, Philippines 180011101121, USA (New York) 8773021657, Canada 8772185618, Nigeria 7080601549. customer.care@sc.com is the published customer-care email for all other accounts. No SMS block keyword is published on the bank's pages.
